fato_historico: 1962: The Yemen Arab Republic is established.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle movement towards building your own personal kingdom of peace. Much like the creation of a new republic, you are invited to establish firm boundaries that protect your heart. Consider how you can govern your own emotions with kindness and grace, allowing your internal landscape to flourish under the golden light of self-compassion.
frase_do_dia: Build your inner sanctuary with patience and deep, unwavering love for yourself.
significado_numero: Represents the path to spiritual wisdom and intuitive emotional growth.
conselho: Focus on grounding your energy by creating a safe space within your home.
